review_description: Couldn't fault them, he took the time to explain everything so I could understand it, and the installers were very good.

From the minute Maria Hobson from Solar Obsession walked through the door, she was cheerful and informative. Maria's knowledge of our needs, the capabiliities and quality of the solar system and the solar hot water system we wanted was impressive. All the questions were answered with accompanying back up information from different sources. The products are reputable products and brands that have been in business for years NOT fly by nights from China.The installation went smoothly and on time. We were off and running by the end of the install day.We are saving heaps of money with lower electricity bills and we don't even have the power turned on to the hot water system and we have FREE hot water from the sun.WE WOULD RECOMMEND SOLAR OBSESSION TO ANYONE WANTING GOOD SERVICE AND VALUE FOR MONEY
Well trained salesperson who listened and responded and followed up and CLOSED the sale.
